description:
FILED s473r (2026-09-07) closing #986: the residue of #900`s compound-assign overload guard, sized.

WHAT IS TRUE TODAY.  `numonly` (task #1183, the Kind-A `numeric-slot`
emission) drops the `+=`/`++` overload guard when the emitter proves the raw
slot can only hold a plain number.  Its third conjunct is `_tw_num_literal`:
every write must be a COMPILE-TIME NUMBER.  So

    my $s = 0; for (1..$n) { $s += $_ }        # $_ is not a literal
    my $c = 0; for my $x (@a) { $c += $x }     # nor is $x

keep the guard, and the guard is worth **15.1 %** of the `intloop+=` bench row
(0.0246 -> 0.0209 s, ab-lisp.pl hand-replacement of the ONE form
`(p-incf-raw $s $_)` -> `(p-incf-raw $s $_ :numeric)`, one core, interleaved,
best-of-7, N = 5e6).  It is not the two tests: with the guard gone SBCL
compiles the body as straight-line arithmetic (%compound-arith-form`s own
docstring measured -62.5 % on the 4e6 `*=`/`%=` loop).

THE WIDENING, and the exact question it turns on.  The guard`s runtime test is
`(and (p-box-p CUR) (p-box-class CUR))` (plus the delta side) â i.e. "is
either operand a BLESSED BOX".  So the licence the emission needs is not "the
slot holds a number" but "neither operand can be a box".  A
`p-foreach-range-raw` counter is exactly that: the loop binds the raw counter
(an integer, or a raw string for a string range), never a box â that is what
the `-raw` in its name means.  Same for a `p-foreach-raw` element of an array
the #1140 facts prove raw-element.

SO THE ITEM IS: give `numonly` a second admissible RHS beside
`_tw_num_literal` â a name the walk has proven to be a RAW LOOP VARIABLE of
the enclosing foreach â and nothing else.  NOT "any raw slot": a B-regime raw
slot DECLINES the freeze and stores `(p-box-init V)` for an overload-capable
value, which is conjunct (2) of the existing licence and the correction #1153
was filed on.

BAR (it is an emission change in the fact machinery, so the full boat):
generation bump + the three artifacts; corpus-diff with every differing file
explained BY SHAPE; emission-ab over the wide list, RCDIFF 0; the FULL SWEEP,
because VarAnnotator is name-resolution-adjacent (the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN table);
`PCL_OPT=none` byte-identical; and the NEGATIVE guard rows that matter --
`my $s=0; for my $o (@objs) { $s += $o }` with an OVERLOADED element MUST keep
the guard and must still answer perl (an @objs the facts do not prove
raw-element is not a raw loop variable), and a `for my $x (@a)` whose body
also does `$x = $obj` is a write to the loop variable and is not raw at all.

PRIZE: 15.1 % of `intloop+=` measured; the shape (accumulate over a loop) is
one of the commonest in perl, so the reach is wide even though the row is a
microbench.  Below the 20 %-of-a-row bar that round 31 shipped against, which
is why s473r filed it instead of taking it.


=== s473s (2026-09-08): NOT TAKEN in perf round 32 — say why, so it is not re-litigated ===

Round 32's brief listed this as member 5, "only if the round has the time".
It did not, and the reason is the shape of the work rather than the clock: this
is a fact-machinery change in VarAnnotator, so it carries the full emission
boat — generation bump, the three artifacts, corpus-diff with every differing
file explained, emission-ab over the wide list, `PCL_OPT=none` byte-identical,
AND the FULL SWEEP (name-resolution-adjacent, per the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN table) —
plus the two NEGATIVE guards, for a lever this task's own filing sized at
15.1 % of `intloop+=`, below the 20 %-of-a-row bar that round 31 shipped
against and the reason s473r filed it instead of taking it.

The round instead spent its budget on two levers that cleared their bars
(#582's own-class half, `methret` -27.5 %; #1461, `textproc` +32.5 % faster)
and on measuring #1518's premise away.  This task is unchanged and still
carries its shape and its two negative guards.
subject: PERF LEVER (sized s473r: 15.1 % of `intloop+=`, below round 31's 20 %-of-a-row bar, so FILED not taken): `numonly` (#1183 `numeric-slot`) gains a SECOND admissible RHS beside a compile-time number -- a proven RAW LOOP VARIABLE of the enclosing foreach (a `p-foreach-range-raw` counter, or a `p-foreach-raw` element of a #1140-proven raw-element array) -- so `$s += $_` / `$c += $x` drop #900's compound-assign overload guard; NOT any raw slot (a B-regime slot can hold a box); full emission boat + the two NEGATIVE guards (overloaded element keeps the guard; a written loop variable is not raw)
